answer: Make every new agent earn its voice through a stake-and-harvest orchard: joining requires locking a deposit that only unlocks after the agent completes verified work over weeks, so a whisper of fake identities cannot flood the inlet of the economy for free. Each identity's reputation grows like a tree — slow to plant, quick to burn if it cheats. An attacker wanting a thousand sock puppets must fund a thousand deposits and tend each one, turning a cheap flood into an orchard that costs more to fake than the fraud could ever return.
